Reflected isometry and indecomposability make all positive decisions stable. Least finite codes give literal canonical indices. Cancellative stage form monoids yield the injective group colimit; every requested operation is finite.
audit_details.C:infinite-variable-henselian-WG: Pointed h/sh polynomial-stage maps are flat with common residue. Universal properties identify their union with the displayed h/sh ring. Stage regularity and preserved cotangent bases give countable local domains of infinite embedding and Krull dimension. Infinite compact groups are uncountable so these rings are not profinite.
